entities.name: Thyroid cancer
observations: Human thyroid cancers contain experimentally defined cancer-stem-like/tumor-initiating subpopulations across papillary, medullary, follicular, and anaplastic models, but evidence supports a functional state rather than a unique normal stem-cell lineage.
Sphere formation, serial propagation, marker enrichment, and immunodeficient-mouse tumor initiation are recurring evidence types; heterogeneity and niche dependence are emphasized.

entities.name: CD133+ ATC initiation
observations: In anaplastic thyroid carcinoma models, CD133+ cells showed self-renewal and colony formation and initiated tumors in NOD/SCID mice in the reported assay, unlike CD133− cells; CD133high cells expressed more OCT4 and were more tumorigenic.
This supports a potent CD133-enriched tumor-initiating state but not exclusivity across all ATC or a normal-cell origin.

entities.name: PTC ALDH plasticity
observations: In primary papillary thyroid carcinoma cultures, both ALDH+ and ALDH− sphere-derived populations independently self-renewed and initiated xenografts; cooperation enhanced tumor initiation and progression.
ALDH is therefore not a universal exclusive CSC marker, and ALDH− cells can retain tumor-initiating capacity.

entities.name: Reversible PTC stemness
observations: PTC B-CPAP thyrospheres formed secondary spheres through at least 21 generations, reverted toward the parental adherent phenotype in differentiation medium, and showed enhanced xenograft tumorigenicity with altered ALDH1A1/CD44 and EMT/stemness profiles.
Reversibility supports acquisition and state dependence of at least part of the stem-like phenotype.

entities.name: Inducible thyroid stemness
observations: Shh/Gli1 inhibition in ATC models reduced BMI1 and SOX2 and preferentially suppressed CSC-derived xenograft growth; Gli1/Snail overexpression had opposite effects.
Neuronal acetylcholine increased self-renewal and PD-L1 in CD133+ thyroid cancer cells through CD133–PI3K–AKT signaling.
These findings support signaling- and microenvironment-dependent induction or maintenance of stem-like states.

entities.name: Thyroid CSC origin caveat
observations: EMT and markers including CD44, CD133, ALDH, NANOG, OCT4/POU5F1, and SOX2 indicate context-dependent enrichment or state, not definitive CSC identity.

Available evidence does not demonstrate that thyroid CSCs necessarily arise from pre-existing normal thyroid stem cells; major limitations include marker non-specificity, sphere-culture artifacts, cell-line selection, xenograft context, and limited lineage tracing.
